title: Sentinel DevOS Foundation Manifest
description: Static, machine-readable repository-foundation manifest introduced by S2 (ML-DEVOS-RFC-001, ML-DEVOS-AS-006, D-016). Descriptive metadata only -- not a Task Engine, Policy Engine, Orchestrator, runtime loader, or enforcement mechanism. Strictly subordinate to the frozen architecture (ML-DEVOS-ARCH-001), the active governance-capability baseline, brain/DECISION_LOG.md decisions, ADRs, and durable Architect Syncs -- this manifest may summarize or reference those records; it may never redefine, weaken, or override them.

architecture_baseline.description: The frozen S0 architecture. MUST remain distinct from sentinel_capability_baseline (S2-F001 / RFC acceptance criterion 2).

sentinel_capability_baseline.description: The active Sentinel governance-capability baseline (S1 Governance Kernel, closed at v1.3.0 by D-013/ML-DEVOS-ADR-001). MUST remain distinct from architecture_baseline.

source_of_truth_precedence.description: Ordered, highest authority first. Must place the frozen architecture, active governance kernel, decisions, ADRs, and durable Architect Syncs above this manifest, and this manifest above the project registry index (S2-F002).

owning_phase.description: Exactly one canonical owning phase per root (S2-F005). Never an array -- a root with more than one owner is a modeling error, not a valid state.

consuming_phases.description: Phases that may consume this root's artifacts once implemented, without owning or redefining the root.

status.description: NOT_IMPLEMENTED for every root reserved for a later phase. FOUNDATION_ACTIVE only for devos/schemas/, which S2 itself owns and populates.

executable_runtime_present.description: MUST be false for every root in S2 -- no reserved root may contain executable later-phase subsystem code (S2-F007, RFC non-goals).

status.description: MUST be EMPTY throughout S2 (RFC acceptance criterion 6/7). Only a later, separately authorized PROJECT_ONBOARDING decision may make this POPULATED.

executable_runtime_present.description: MUST be false -- S2 is a static repository foundation only; no Task/Policy/Capability/Orchestrator/Evidence runtime, CI, or ruleset exists (RFC acceptance criterion 5/12).
